layers.orbit: Low scrap ring. No traffic beacons. A quiet place to hold station.
layers.atmosphere: Thin, hot, and only breathable as a boast.
layers.surface: Glass plains and ash dunes. The keel would scrape, not land.
layers.crust: Cinder-ore in shallow seams a drone can cut.
layers.biosign: Nothing the probe will swear to.
layers.ruins: A burned landing spine, decades cold.

layers.orbit: A wet moon and a band of spore dust. Science traffic, irregular.
layers.atmosphere: Thick, sour, and storm-banded. Skim only.
layers.surface: Peat shelves and black water under a low sun.
layers.crust: Mire peat in the shelves. It spoils if you dawdle.
layers.biosign: Mats, not minds. The probe flags a living crust.
layers.ruins: A collapsed greenhouse ring on the night side.
layers.legal: Leased to an independent survey desk. Extraction is tolerated and written down.

layers.orbit: Highport lights and a Compact beacon. You are being read.
layers.atmosphere: Cold, clean, and patrolled. Aerobrake vanes would matter here later.
layers.surface: Rime plains and charter markers. Not a place for the keel.
layers.crust: Vellum rime, valuable and explicitly protected.
layers.biosign: Cultured lichen under the rime. Compact property.
layers.ruins: A pre-charter shrine the Compact fenced and did not explain.
layers.legal: Planetary Defense Organization: Vellum Compact. Cutting the crust writes heat.
